messages:
alex: quick heads-up — CI perf run on latest runtime shows a latency regression for causal flows when FlashAttention v3 is selected and head_dim == 96. baseline (v2) was ~18ms/token, v3 path jumps to ~28ms/token on A100. looks like the GPU kernel choice is the culprit.

maya: ugh, that's the head-dim edge case we suspected. v3 has a different tile/warp schedule that doesn't align well with 96. are we falling back to v2 automatically?

lee: current autotuner picks kernel based on (model_arch, seqlen, head_dim, causal) but the cost model was trained on multiples of 64 and 128. 96 isn't represented so the estimator mispredicts.

alex: right — observed behavior: for non-causal it's picking FA v3 non-causal kernel and perf is fine; for causal the kernel uses a different masked memory pattern and kernel occupancy drops. fallback to v2 (or SDPA) restores perf.

sam: can we add a quick heuristic: if causal && head_dim % 32 != 0 -> prefer v2? i know it's hacky but would stop regression fast.

maya: +1 for emergency heuristic, but let's gate it behind a flag and log telemetry. also add a metric in Console so customers get alerted if fallback happens a lot.

lee: agreed. I'll push a patch to the autotuner to include a small lookup table for head_dim anomalies and seqlen buckets. autotuner will still try v3 on a short microbench run before committing decision. pseudo: 

```bash
# runtime autotune check (microbench)
python infra/bench_kernel.py --model gpt-small --head-dim 96 --seqlen 128 --causal true --try-kernels flashattn_v3,flashattn_v2,sdpa
# pick kernel with lowest p95 latency and stable memory usage
```

alex: nice. add a timeout (200ms) so we don't block requests on the bench. also ensure KV cache hot-path doesn't trigger bench for every request — only on first N warmups per replica or when model config changes.

sam: KV cache note: if we swap kernels mid-life, the kv layout differs and we need a conversion path or a replica drain. we should prefer a canary-style rollout: choose kernel per-replica, let existing KV continue on old kernel until TTL, then migrate.

maya: good catch. that's why console needs per-replica kernel view and a rollout toggle. I'll add a card for UX.

deploy-bot: perf-test/1790129876 started (suite: flashattn-regressions, target: a100-cluster).

infra-bot: microbench job 1790129901 queued -> runner-7. expected ~3m.

lee: I'll open a PR for the heuristic + bench wrapper. plan: short-term heuristic flag, mid-term: retrain estimator with head_dim 32/48/96/160 samples, long-term: analytic cost model for causal masking.

alex: perfect. add unit tests that simulate head_dim 96 + causal and assert fallback path annotated in logs. then merge behind feature-flag.

sam: can someone add a short note in incidents if customers saw errors? I scanned logs, no errors, only higher p95. file a postmortem if this rolls out and affects SLO.

maya: will do — adding to eng-runtime backlog: "autotuner: head_dim anomaly table + bench wrapper + per-replica rollout". tagging @alex @lee. :thumbsup: 

alex: thanks all. ping when PR is ready and when the deploy-bot marks staging green.
